final.explanation: With a reference, center = apparent_displacement_m - reference.displacement_m = -5.938e-09 - (-2.333e-08) = 1.739e-08 m. sigma = sqrt(1e-18 + 1e-18 - 0) = 1.414e-09 m. B = reference.residual_bound_m = 1e-09 m. h = 1.959963984540054*sigma + B = 2.77e-09 + 1e-09 = 3.77e-09 m. The 95% interval is [center-h, center+h] = [1.362e-08, 2.116e-08] m. Resolution T = -resolution_m = -1e-08 m. Since upper (2.116e-08) <= T (-1e-08) is false and lower (1.362e-08) > T (-1e-08) is true, the entire interval lies above T, ruling out inward motion beyond resolution. Thus compression_not_supported.
